subject: Karim Benzema
title: Benzema: landslide, then a kart joke

lines.vo: Benzema won the 2022 Ballon d'Or by three hundred and fifty-six points.
That is not a win. That is a lap of honour.
In 2024-25 he scored twenty-one league goals in twenty-eight games for Al-Ittihad. League and King's Cup double.
In 2020 he compared Olivier Giroud to karting, and himself to Formula One. Modest as ever.
At Al-Hilal he scored a hat-trick on debut in a six-nil win. Six months later, he was gone. Fast car, short race.
Now his Saudi ambassador deal pays about twenty-three million dollars a year. Play abroad and it is cancelled. Formula One, parked in a very comfy pit lane.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.
